title: Direct revision changes
responsibility: Combines recorded impact with registry-version differences to identify what a commit itself changed.

inputs.name: revisionChanges.input
inputs.description: Stored impact or null, current registry, optional parent registry and fallback parent commit. Registry comparison requires both registries to be available.

outputs.name: revisionChanges
outputs.description: Sorted direct, added and removed unit ids with the parent commit, or null when neither impact nor comparable registries exist. Indirect dependents are excluded; added/removed ids are removed from direct.
